title: Audit stale protected CURRENT, Canon-lineage validator, report, and writable workflow changes without overwriting current authority or enabling repository writes
reason: PR 187 attempted a useful CURRENT-lineage reconciliation in August 2026, but its protected handbook is now a dated checkpoint, its PR graph and external observations are stale, its validator contains an overbroad superseded-reference bypass, its report lacks the current fail-closed regression assertions, and its workflow would regress current CI while restoring actions:write, contents:write, direct pushes to main, and Pages workflow dispatch. Exact current main already contains a stricter validator, newer report assertions, current action versions, broader tests, and a read-only artifact-only Digital Ant successor. The safe action is a current-main audit record only, with no protected CURRENT, validator, report, or workflow transplanted.

inventory.security_blocker: The audited workflow can write and push main and dispatch Pages, while the audited validator's broad historical/superseded keyword regex can suppress active contradictory CURRENT rules.

blocking_findings: PR 187 is open, Draft, unmerged, diverged, and 747 commits behind exact current main; its PR body and sole comment describe August 2026 main/head and a 41-open-PR checkpoint rather than present repository state.

The protected handbook candidate is version V1.4 dated 2026-08-27 and embeds point-in-time PR heads, divergence, CI, BSC blocks, balances, pair observations, payroll figures, open-PR counts, and workstream states. Those records are history, not current authority.

The handbook says PR 173 is Ready and unmerged, but PR 173 merged on 2026-09-13. It also treats PRs 170, 171, 176, 185, 169, 163, 164, and 165 as active candidates although each is now closed unmerged; PRs 160 and 184 are now merged.
The handbook's 36- and 41-open-PR checkpoints are stale; exact current inventory has 34 open PRs.

The handbook repeatedly requires distinct independent review for ordinary repository work. Current Human-owner merge policy explicitly removes ceremonial distinct-reviewer gating where GitHub does not require it, while retaining action-specific authority for protected live effects.

The audited validator treats any line containing broad terms such as SUPERSEDED, historical, obsolete, 歷史, or 舊 as an exempt reference. An active contradictory rule can therefore evade detection merely by including one of those words.

Exact current main replaced that broad regex with a closed allowlist of exact superseded-reference lines and added supersededReferenceScopeFailsClosed plus explicitSupersededReferencesRecognized regression assertions.
The audited reconciliation report lacks the two current fail-closed assertions and is not the exact output of the current main validator.

The audited workflow grants actions:write and contents:write to a scheduled or manually dispatched Digital Ant job, commits generated files, rebases, pushes directly to main, and dispatches deploy-pages-static.yml with GITHUB_TOKEN.
Merging that workflow is explicitly outside automatic authority because it restores direct-main writes and workflow dispatch and can use a repository token.
The audited workflow uses actions/checkout@v4 and actions/setup-node@v4 and emits Node.js 20 deprecation warnings, whereas current main uses v7 actions.

The audited workflow runs only the older 238-test Universal suite and core syntax. Current main additionally validates engineering-cycle security, workflow security, native-market behavior, and tests syntax across core and tests, with 302/302 latest code-equivalent tests.
Current main preserves Digital Ant output as an artifact with contents:read rather than committing or pushing main. The audited writable implementation must not replace that safer successor.

Historical BSC balances, contract reads, pair absence, payroll figures, and wallet balances in the handbook are dated observations and cannot prove current controller, signer, funding, liquidity, custody, payment, settlement, revenue, or deployment authority.

Historical exact-head green CI proves the old branch is internally consistent at that commit only. It cannot make stale lineage current, authorize protected CURRENT replacement, or authorize repository, workflow, financial, governance, or chain effects.
positive_findings: The PR intended to separate deployed facts, current design Canon, review candidates, superseded history, and open review items, and it repeatedly labels live execution boundaries fail-closed.

The validator adds CURRENT-section scoping, case-folded tracked-path lookup, archive existence checks, SUPERSEDED header checks, scale reconciliation, report generation, and exact committed-report verification.
The historical exact-head push and pull-request workflows both succeeded; the pull-request run reported 238/238 Universal tests, CURRENT lineage PASS, and an unchanged generated report.
The pull-request event skipped the writable Digital Ant job, so the historical PR CI itself did not push main or dispatch Pages.
No Solidity diff, deployment, transaction, payment, asset transfer, Worker/Life activation, signer access, or chain mutation is contained in the four-file PR diff itself.
safe_successor_requirements: Rebuild any handbook update from exact latest main, classifying every referenced PR by current merged, closed-unmerged, open-Draft, superseded, or historical state and binding observations to explicit dates and SHAs.

Do not copy historical open-PR counts, divergence, balances, pair absence, payroll, wallet, liquidity, deployment, controller, signer, or authority observations into CURRENT claims without fresh authoritative evidence.
Preserve the current validator's exact superseded-reference allowlist and regression probes. Never use broad historical or old keyword matching to exempt a full line from contradiction checks.
Preserve current workflow-security, engineering-cycle, native-market, and syntax suites plus current action versions; do not regress to the smaller historical test set.

Keep Digital Ant and similar automation contents:read and artifact-only. Any future repository write, direct-main push, workflow dispatch, secret/token use, external API, or agent launch requires separate explicit Human authorization for that exact side effect.
Change protected CURRENT or Canon only through a bounded exact-current-main successor with explicit semantic diff, dependency reconciliation, exact-head CI, and no live execution implication.

Keep ordinary low-risk repository integration authority separate from payment, treasury, Mainnet, signer, governance, custody, deployment, Worker/Life, controller, operator, or external-publication authority.

Never execute payment, transfer assets, access credentials, appoint roles, dispatch workflows, launch external agents, send Mainnet transactions, execute governance, or mutate chain state as part of this audit.

audited_old_head.non_blocking_warning: actions/checkout@v4 and actions/setup-node@v4 target the deprecated Node.js 20 action runtime and were forced to Node.js 24

exact_current_main.code_equivalence: Only document-only lineage work orders changed between the tested code SHA and exact current main.

path_classification.disposition: Do not restore actions:write, contents:write, direct-main push, Pages dispatch, deprecated actions, or the reduced historical test set.
Retain the candidate as historical evidence; rebuild any protected CURRENT successor from exact latest main and fresh PR/chain state.
Keep the current report with scoped superseded-reference regression assertions; do not replace it with the older generated report.
Preserve current exact-line allowlist and fail-closed probes; reject the broad historical/old keyword bypass.

acceptance: All four merge-base-to-audited-head paths appear exactly once with exact merge-base, audited-head, and current-main blob SHAs.
Classification counts sum to four and selected_candidate_count is exactly one.
PR 187 remains open, Draft, unmerged, and explicitly HOLD; this work order does not close, update, refresh, or merge it.

Protected CURRENT staleness, live PR-state divergence, workflow write permissions, direct-main push, workflow dispatch, validator bypass, report regression, CI reduction, and deprecated actions are recorded.
No protected CURRENT, Canon, workflow, validator, report, PR state, external observation, authority, or live-effect code is transplanted.
No UI or game code changes in this audit, so target-specific browser screenshot QA is not applicable.

No payment, asset transfer, Mainnet transaction, Worker/Life activation, role appointment, private-key access, governance execution, external publication, workflow dispatch, paid API, external agent, or chain-state action is performed.
